channel.title: QuickDash
channel.description: QuickDash is a floating overlay utility hub for Android featuring 12 tools — UPI QR, translator, clipboard, notes, calculator, Wi-Fi sharing, and more.

item.title: QuickDash v5.1.2 Released
item.description: Security improvements, catch block hardening, type-safe navigation, comprehensive testing, version bump to 5.1.2.

item.title: QuickDash v5.1.1 Released
item.description: Android 16 (API 36) target, 16KB page alignment, bug fixes and performance improvements.

item.title: QuickDash is Now Open Source
item.description: QuickDash has been released as open source under the PocketOps Custom Open Source Fork License. Source code available on GitHub.
